# ErnestPath

> ErnestPath is a specialist enrollment growth agency for coaching and training institutes in India — website development, SEO, and Google/Meta Ads focused on turning search demand into filled batches. ErnestPath Academy teaches the MERN stack through real client-style projects and freelance-readiness training.

## Services
- [SEO for Coaching Institutes](https://ernestpath.com/services/seo)
- [Website Development for Coaching Institutes](https://ernestpath.com/services/website-development)
- [Google & Meta Ads for Coaching Institutes](https://ernestpath.com/services/ads)

## Academy
